title: AXES Directory pilot correction and removal request record
description: Formal encoding of the proposed correction/removal request record table in docs/AXES_DIRECTORY_DATA_MODEL.md. Documentation and fixture validation only. Contact identity, correspondence, evidence, and free-form request content are intentionally excluded from this schema; they belong in a restricted operator system, not this record.

request_route.description: Controlled route label for the published correction/removal channel.

resolution_code.description: Controlled outcome code; never personal details or free-form correspondence.

allOf.comment: A human reviewer's decision (implemented, declined, or closed) must record when it happened.
